newsitem.title: USA: US PLAINS FED CATTLE TRADE LIGHT AT $64 - FEEDLOTS.
newsitem.headline: US PLAINS FED CATTLE TRADE LIGHT AT $64 - FEEDLOTS.

text.p: U.S. Plains fed cattle early Friday sold at $64.00 per cwt in thin trading, feedlot sources said. The sales were steady with Thursday, but down $1.00 from earlier this week and down $2.00 from last week's top.

About 500 head sold in the Texas Panhandle and western Oklahoma area early following sales of about 5,000 at $64.00 on Thursday. There were no reported sales in Kansas following about 1,000 head on Thursday at $64.00.
Further bids at $64.00 early Friday in the Panhandle and Kansas were rebuffed by many cattle owners still holding out for $65.00, the feedlot sources said.
